prose: Check out this excellent show I did with Cam from Enter the Mystery. Definitely felt like meeting myself at the beginning of the podcast journey and I massively love this dude already, so make sure you sub to his channel and keep your third ear open for his work. It was cool to be lucky episode number 13.
topics: The path of Darth Vader vs. Luke Skywalker
Natural law of the land vs. paper based artificial reality of the legal system
The magical energy behind reality, language, ritual
Learning true history of the incredible ancient civilizations that existed on this planet
